'''Glah Ubooki's Strange & Wondrous Imports''' was the name of eighteen different shops run by the [[Ubooki brothers]]. Located on eighteen different planets including [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], each was run by a [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] who called himself "[[Glah Ubooki (alias)|Glah Ubooki]]" and claimed that his store was the only such store in existence.
